coalesce_ticks.unit: ticks (delta = 2 min, design R4; the design gives no mapping id)

stall_calls.unit: model calls (c, design R5; a reading until the pilot measures it)

hang_ticks.unit: ticks (h, design R5 as built; read by no script since FX-W6, whose kind deadlines model_ticks, tool_slack_ticks and bg_wait_ticks replace it)

loop_k.unit: identical tool-call signatures in a row (design R5)

R.unit: attempts replaced after a failure (design R8)

H_max.unit: hand-overs plus parks per task (design R8)

Z_frac.unit: fraction of a task's e_task (zombie spend, design R9)

stop_verify_deltas.unit: ticks of non-growth before a stop is confirmed (design R9, 2 delta)

N_max.unit: live child processes (design R10); computed by the decision rule (r57-0414), memory one of its widths, measured per session (Q19); a guess until then

N_ceiling.unit: live child processes, the upper bound of N_max (design R10); computed by the decision rule (r57-0414), not a fixed three (r57-0032); a guess until then

reserve_mb.unit: MB (free memory kept back, design R10)

soft_frac.unit: fraction of e_task: the child is told to commit (design R11)

hard_frac.unit: fraction of e_task: the task is cut (design R11)

B_tokens.unit: tokens (cap; null = not set, a reading, design F4). Set from PILOT-PLAN.md s2: the rows expected 126.3 M + their overrun 45.3 M

r_tokens.unit: tokens (margin; null = not set, a reading, design F4). Set from PILOT-PLAN.md s2: the rows share of the pooled reserve, sqrt of the summed squared spreads

alarm_ms.unit: ms (long silence before the alarm exits, design R6)

W_star_coord.unit: tokens (coordinator hand-over window, cost.mjs compute rounded to 100, design R50)

coord_over_factor.unit: times W_star_coord (audit flags a coordinator turn above it, design R50)

W_quality.unit: tokens (quality line, the coordinator's figure, design 12)

W_star_child.unit: tokens (only under option b of the research child's window, design R49; null = reading)

child_prefix_tokens.unit: tokens (the child's first-call context, cost inputs child P; a reading until measured)

review_reserve_tokens.unit: tokens (a fresh reviewer's pack, cost inputs review pack; a reading until measured)

lean_baseline_tokens.unit: tokens (first-call context of the control session, design R22; null until measured)

lean_tolerance_tokens.unit: tokens (tolerance around the lean baseline, design R22; null until measured)

w_chars.unit: characters between quote and number (design R25)

window_words.unit: words of snapshot around the offset (design R26)

d0.unit: detection rate a checker class must show (design R42)

seeds_per_class_per_call.unit: seeds of one class in one checker call (design R42)

proof_seed_share.unit: fraction of later batches that are seeds (design R42, later)

plants_k.unit: wrong assumptions planted per expert (design R44)

plants_t.unit: plants that must be found out of k (design R44; computed from the pilot's measurements against the objective, not the owner's, r57-0001/0002; null = reading)

unverifiable_share_max.unit: share of unverifiable cards (design R45; computed from the pilot's measurements against the objective, not the owner's, r57-0001/0002; null = reading)

coverage_floor.unit: held-out seed recall (a reading in the pilot, design R45)

unattributed_share_max.unit: share of tokens not attributable (cost.mjs from-transcripts, design R52)

blind_fail_rate.unit: scorer's arm-guess rate above which blinding failed (design 11)

fill_factor.unit: f, fraction of a leaf filled at bulk load (design R47, later)

replan_ratio.unit: actual over estimate that triggers a re-plan (design R52, later)

index_words.unit: words per mechanism summary in a two-level pack (design R17)

f5_given.unit: owner word for the fetch script (design F5). Set from PILOT-PLAN.md s4: F5 on, derived; takes effect with the owner go, which names the snapshots

allow_loopback.unit: tests only: let snap.mjs fetch 127.0.0.1 (design R25)

hook_deadline_ms.unit: ms (guard-hook answers within this, design R29)

intake_step_timeout_ms.unit: ms one watch --intake step may run before it is ended (fix-U1)

sleep_gap_ms.unit: ms (a gap between two ticks read as a PC suspend; information only)

lock_retries.unit: retries of the run lock, 100 ms apart (about 30 s)

s2_allowed.unit: the second control run (design 12; derived against the objective, not the owner option, r57-0001/0002). Set from PILOT-PLAN.md s4 Section 12 options: without S2 every difference reads no difference shown

crossed_design_allowed.unit: the crossed design pack B (design 11; derived against the objective, not the owner's option, r57-0001/0002; false until derived)

H_nostart.unit: no-start fences of a failure reason left uncharged in a row (FX-CLAIM, FIX-fence 2 step 2, N7; a guess)

start_lease_ticks.unit: ticks a start record waits for a claim or a transcript (FX-CLAIM lease, N3; no design value: hang_ticks; a guess until PROBE 5)

start_lease_ms.unit: ms, wall floor of the start lease (FX-CLAIM N3; start_lease_ticks x delta_ms; a guess until PROBE 5)

stop_verify_ms.unit: ms, wall floor of stop verify's no-growth window (FX-CLOSE step 5c, N3; stop_verify_deltas x delta_ms; a guess)

ensure_query_ms.unit: ms, timeout of the ensure's one process query (FX-W2 step 3; a guess)

release_ms.unit: ms reconcile waits at least for the nonces (FX-W2 step 6; a guess)

arm_confirm_ms.unit: ms reconcile waits at most for the nonces: ensure_query_ms + the lock wait 30 s + 5 s (FX-W2 step 6; a guess)

alarm_slots.unit: alarm slots per ce (FX-W2, branch S1, build/branches.md row 4; a guess)

realert_runs.unit: dead-man runs between alerts while one cause holds (FX-W4 rev 5, branch P1: 30 min at 5-min runs; a guess)

stuck_raises.unit: raises at the capped interval, condition unchanged, before an act-due is stuck (FX-W5 step 3, branch R1; a guess)

idle_ticks.unit: ticks of an idle child before act-due idle-child (FX-W6 step 4, branch B1; a guess)

attempt_max_ticks.unit: counted ticks of an attempt before act-due age-cap (FX-W6 step 5, a placeholder; a guess)

tool_slack_ticks.unit: ticks past a tool call's declared timeout before a hang (FX-W6 step 3, kind tool, branch B1; a guess)

bg_wait_ticks.unit: ticks of a wait on a background task before a hang (FX-W6 step 3, kind bg-wait, branch B1; a guess)

model_ticks.unit: ticks of one model call before a hang (FX-W6 step 3, kind model, branch B1; a guess)

watcher_lock_try_ms.unit: ms the watcher tries the run lock before it skips the tick (FX-W7 step 2; a guess)

busy_alert_ticks.unit: busy ticks before the dead-man alerts (FX-W7 step 2, FX-W4; a guess)

proc_exe.unit: absolute path of PowerShell (process information, a test seam)

user_files.unit: user-level files whose hash goes into the manifest (design R22)

tcb_paths_protected.unit: path prefixes under the run root (design R29)

weights.unit: ratios to one input token: cache read, cache write, output (no currency; cost inputs tag M)
